chapter: Interferometry, quantum optics and photon statistics

variants.title: Intensity correlations with a fast-spinning disc
variants.sample: Pseudo-thermal light, disc spun faster (coherence time 20 microseconds)
variants.note: A faster disc decorrelates the speckle sooner: the central peak is narrower, so the bins are 2.5 microseconds wide. g2(0) is unchanged.

source.title: Illustrative design values
source.note: set by the lab for this condition; not taken from a named instrument's datasheet

variants.title: Intensity correlations with ten times fewer photons
variants.sample: Pseudo-thermal light, count rate 6 x 10^4 per second on each counter
variants.note: Ten times fewer photons per counter: the coincidence bins hold far fewer counts, but g2(0) is still 2 because it is a ratio.
